photos_h2: What we have been working on

reviews.author: Kimberly Sluder-Pangle
reviews.text: We have previously had our RV tires serviced at the Black's Tire and Automotive in Fayetteville NC. They went above and beyond and we were very pleased with their work. Yesterday. We needed trailer tires replaced and visited the Sanford NC location. The staff was helpful and friendly. The technician was as well. However, we were charged $31.98 for balancing 2 tires when they did not provide that service. We appreciate their prompt attention, but we will not return to that location.

reviews.author: D RS
reviews.text: We've always had a nice experience and everyone is always very friendly and helpful. This visit we had a little confusion but Jessica was extremely helpful and went above and beyond in making everything right. Greatly appreciate her and her team!

reviews.author: eric cuffee
reviews.text: Black's Tire and Auto are life savers. Even while short handed, they were able to squeeze me in for another nail in my tire. The forth one this year. Thanks for the warm and friendly customer service.

reviews.author: Dannie Beal
reviews.text: Was in there at 4..they jumped rite on my truck installing 4 new tires all good out by 5:15...good people there..thankx Blacks

reviews.author: Dawayne Raines
reviews.text: Got them to do a front alignment and it’s still not accurate Don’t say nothing about charging to start a front alignment or something is wrong. They still want to charge you extra speed.

reviews.author: Thomas Wright
reviews.text: I had a leaking front tire and worn tires on my HVAC van. Black's Tire & Auto on Main St. got me in and changed all 4 tires and sensors in about 2 hours. Super job and customer service! Highly recommend.

reviews.author: C Wayne
reviews.text: I feel like I sorta got ripped off. I got a 4 wheel alignment done and for the few minor adjustments done to my car. I don't think It was worth $125 still better than what Mavis was going to charge that was $130 some. The car feels the same before and after I came In. I replaced the tie rods myself and I sort of new the right side toe was going to be off quit a bit because I adjusted It before and after installing the new tie rods. Overall a few adjustments where done as seen in this photo of the report. I'm sorta glad I did get It because I know when I get a new tire that was damaged from being out of alignment or the camber being wrong when I bought the car at least I know It's in range. I have mixed fillings but overall I'm extremely satisfied with how long It took for It to be completed.

reviews.author: Sharon McKoy
reviews.text: Went to get my brakes checked and needed brake pads and rotors. I was in and out in 1.5 hours. Service was good and hassle free.

reviews.author: Crystal Hickman
reviews.text: The most excellent service and best price. Highly recommend for all your vehicle needs. The manager Tony is very knowledgeable and helpful.

reviews.author: Derric Eck
reviews.text: I had my problematic factory air suspension removed and replaced with shocks and springs on my Mercedes SUV . Drives, rides, and handles beautifully! They are very knowledgeable, professional, and friendly! Highly recommended!!!

reviews.author: Chris Bryant
reviews.text: Been to several Blacks tire shop but this was the worst one of all. Took my Audi for tires and oil change, left bolts off my splash cover causing it to fly off and rip in half. Then after getting the tires on, they proceed to come and tell me they're unable to do the tire alignment on my car instead of saying this before putting tires on my car. The lady at the desk never took one class in customer service. Overall horrible. Will not go back there ever.

reviews.author: Emily Harrison
reviews.text: Incredibly kind and helpful staff, helped me out in a pinch when I got a screw in my tire. It didn't take but five minutes for them to get it sorted.

reviews.author: lisa mcneill
reviews.text: 0/10 was trying to figure out what was wrong with my car. The guy at the front kept mumbling and he had an accent, when I asked him what he said and what it meant he kept huffing and puffing and continued to mumble so I left still not knowing what was wrong with my car.

reviews.author: Pete Shandrick
reviews.text: Always the best service! Tony and Jessica are the best in the business and will make sure you are well taken care of and that you receive quality work at an affordable price! Whether you need an oil change, tires for your truck or boat trailer, brakes, or some other service, Go see the Sanford Blacks Tire team!

reviews.author: Jared Richardson
reviews.text: I am 16 years old and my tire was popped on my 2006 Honda Civic, I was in and out in 30 minutes, 20 for the wait and 10 for the repair. Everyone was really nice and got it done quickly. Also it was pretty affordable. Great shop and I recommend it to everyone.

reviews.author: Mason Blell
reviews.text: I went here not knowing the exact tires that I wanted to get for my truck. Tony, the manager, helped me every step of the way when deciding the correct tires to go with. When we finally decided the tires to go with he gave me a great deal on them. I felt valued and appreciated as a customer. My family and I will definitely continue to do business with them.

reviews.author: Robert Mooney
reviews.text: Set an appointment to mount my 37 x 12.5 r17 and was quoted a price whe. I arrive for my appointment was told they were too big

reviews.author: stanley collier
reviews.text: I didn't like the fact that this mark the second time I got my car service for an oil change. And I was 2nd customer in line and it takes 2hrs to finish servicing my car. Also my car is returned to parking lot and then another 15 mins to inform that my car is ready for checking out for payment. Just don't understand why??

reviews.author: Shu'Diamond Utley
reviews.text: Mrs. Jessica was so understanding and helpful in my distress this morning. She kindly educated me on my car’s tire issues and made sure I was well taken care of. Her professionalism and customer service care is excellent. I highly recommend specifically this black tire and auto service store location. Thank you all again!

reviews.author: Cameron Brown
reviews.text: This is a fair, fast, and reliable auto shop. Every service I've had makes me appreciate these folks more. I recommend it to anyone in the area.

reviews.author: Lisa Marie
reviews.text: Love Blacks! They take care of all of my familys fleet. From the techs.. to our favorite Queen in charge, Jessica! Blacks is honest, reliable, and fast! I trust them with our new older honda to our brand new kia and dodge.

reviews.author: Tammy Hale
reviews.text: The service was excellent. I went in for inspection, the replacement of my back brake lights. Service was fast, fair price and excellent customer service.. I will be back!

reviews.author: Socrates Dominguez
reviews.text: This is a very professional establishment. The mechanics know what they are doing. They work quick but they get the job done right. The service feels like an old 1950 garage friendliness with a modern care. Excellent service station, highly recommend. The prices of repairs are very reasonable.

reviews.author: Amy Farrish
reviews.text: Had a great experience! Had a new set of tires put on with alignment and my car was ready to go in no time! Lady at the desk was super nice. This was my first time back there in many years and I was pleased with everything.

reviews.author: Kathy Sheffield
reviews.text: The employee's were very nice and considerate.. They gave me their full attention. I had a great experience. Thank you

reviews.author: James Moore
reviews.text: Jessica was outstanding, she got my tires there within thirty minutes of me inquiring and out the tires.

reviews.author: Rosetta Dykes
reviews.text: I was given respect and attention at black’s tire for my bad tire.So I am a regular customer from now on.

reviews.author: Len Wilson
reviews.text: Tony was very helpful went getting the right tires for my Ram 3500 dually. After having tires installed and alignment done the ride is very smooth and quiet at highway speed. Will return to Blacks for additional service needs.

reviews.author: Nancy Barnes
reviews.text: I had went to two other shops in Sanford, NC to get a vehicle inspection. One shop didn’t have an inspector. Their sister shop opened at 8am and was t open when I left at 8:10am. I went to Black’s Tire and Auto Service and they got me in and out with my inspection in less than 30 minutes and I had time to make it to the tag office before 9am. Thank you so much for your friendly interaction and great customer service.

reviews.author: Marie
reviews.text: I love this place. Prices are fair, service is efficient, and everyone has always been polite, which is hard to come by these days. They even actually put air in your tires when getting an oil change or tire rotation, something other places check off as done, but they don't really do. I love this place!

reviews.author: Sarah Cessna
reviews.text: Truly amazing people working here! We were about 30 minutes from home when a piece of metal stuck in our tire. We had to pull over and I was alone with my two kids- the guys at BTS helped me tremendously! A stressful situation quickly diffused and BTS is to thank for that! I appreciate their assistance very much and will be telling others about their truly great customer service

reviews.author: Marti B
reviews.text: Was mostly pleased with the overall service. I asked that the auto info on the steering wheel be the same after the service. My oil data was put where my tire pressure should have been. I was able to change it back by using my manual. I will continue my services with your company. Every one was very pleasant and helpful. The service was completed on a timely manner.

reviews.author: Robert Guthrie
reviews.text: I was told I was next in line for an inspection. 1 hr. Or so later they pulled my vehicle in to inspect it. After I went to counter to ask how long it would be. The inspection bay was empty the entire time.

reviews.author: Roberto Ayala
reviews.text: Went to discount tires first to get some new tires installed, but was told The tires could not be stretched. Went to Black tires and they installed them right away appreciate yall.

reviews.author: GEORGE CAULDER
reviews.text: I cannot praise Blacks Tire & Auto Service enough for their outstanding service and automotive expertise! From the moment I walked in, I was greeted warmly by their friendly staff, who immediately made me feel like a valued customer.I recently had a set of tires put on my truck, and I was thoroughly impressed by the professionalism and efficiency of their team. Tony took the time to explain the options in the different tires and provided transparent recommendations and options for my truck and after a few hundred miles on the new tires, I am totally satisfied with Tony's recommendation. Their honesty and integrity were truly refreshing in an industry where trust can sometimes be hard to come by.The facility itself is clean and well-maintained, creating a comfortable atmosphere for customers. Additionally, their pricing is fair and competitive, offering great value for the exceptional service they provide.Overall, I highly recommend Blacks Tire & Auto Service to anyone in need of tires or any automotive repairs or maintenance. They have earned my trust and loyalty as a customer, and I will definitely be returning for all of my future automotive needs. Thank you, Blacks Tire & Auto Service for your dedication to excellence and customer satisfaction!

reviews.author: T Green
reviews.text: We have come here twice in the past month, once for a new tire, second time for an oil change. The new tire took 4 hours and the oil change took 2 hours. There was only 3 vehicles in the bays (including ours). We will not be coming here again.

reviews.author: Jennell Matthews
reviews.text: Excellent service from the time I walked in the door until I was handed my keys back at completion. The first time I stopped in to get a quote Jessica was extremely helpful and very pleasant! So I knew I found the right shop. When I brought my car in Bonnie had the the best customer service I’ve encountered in a long time. I especially loved the fact that they were honest about the services I needed and didn’t need. That’s a rare quality that I respect because usually others try to recommend any and everything you don’t need. And I will be using them for all of my vehicles from here on out.

reviews.author: Reggie Cox
reviews.text: I was very pleased with the service that I received. The people were very professional and courteous. Good people to deal with.

reviews.author: Paul Hollis
reviews.text: Negative 5 Stars they caused a problem with my left front wheel when I'm doing a alignment on the car. and denied accountability,so now Ihave to pay to fix it, so I do not recommend anyone going to them unless they want to get ripped off

reviews.author: alexandra echols
reviews.text: Extremely friendly, knowledgeable, kind and personable staff. I was In and out in no time and with a reasonable bill. I felt like my business actually mattered to the employees there, who genuinely seemed to enjoy their job. Would absolutely recommend.

reviews.author: Judith Wojick-Edmonds
reviews.text: Very quick and efficient turnaround to repair a tire with a nail in it. Super courteous employees who took the time to explain things and show me exactly what was going on. Reasonable price also!

reviews.author: Tamara Harrington
reviews.text: I walked in and was met by friendly folks- I had just washed and vacuumed out my car, and the tech took extra care in putting down a paper floor mat. He drove it around to the Bay Area, replaced my taillight and I was ready to go in about 10 minutes. Price was very reasonable!

reviews.author: Emily Grant
reviews.text: Great service, and great, down to earth people. I don't feel like they see me as a walking dollar sign, and they've always been upfront with me. Everyone I talk to there is a sweetheart, gives Greta friendly service. Very quick; never waited there more than an hour.

reviews.author: Becca Nalesnik
reviews.text: The first/only time I went was last Thursday for 5 new tires and alignment. Checkout was uneventful and I even chatted with the employee for a bit. Got to the car, noticed all 4 hubcap covers in the front seat. It’s pouring rain and I head back to work. I notice the next evening that the caps HAVE ALL BEEN BROKEN AND TOSSED ON THE SEAT WITH ALL THE BROKEN PEICES! Not one employee called me about it before pick up, talked to me about it AT pickup, and haven’t heard anything since. Zero out of ten. Not one employee has any integrity. Will only warn others of this place.

reviews.author: Diane Chubet
reviews.text: The front desk man was awesome! I had a very nice experience. My car was inspected in a professional manner. I also got a quote for tires and I will be back! I m going to tell my daughter to start going to your establishment.

reviews.author: Allison Durham
reviews.text: Blacks tire always does a good job with my car. I’ve gotten tires and brakes from them as well as oil changes and rotations, and most recently they replaced a thermostat when my check engine light came on. They fixed the problem and the car runs great. They are always nice and professional. I highly recommend this business!

reviews.author: Elaine Wilderson
reviews.text: This place is AWESOME!!! Arrived at work with a big hole in my tire. Called (they open at 7:30 am!) and the manager himself came out to jack up my car and remove the tire. Then Jessica called and let me pay over the phone. Within an hour, I had a new tire on my car without me leaving the parking lot!!!! And they didn't even charge me for roadside service. I just cannot say enough good things about this place. They have customer service down to a fine art.

reviews.author: James guydish
reviews.text: I had my car at three places and lastly Blacks tire did a road force balance on my tires and the car now drives like I’m on a cloud. You won’t be sorry if you have them work on your car. They are also very nice to you when you enter and treat you like you should be treated. Well they did it again on my truck which everyone said was to ride rough, after the road force balance and rotation I now have a what seems like new truck. Thank you all so much for the great service.

reviews.author: John Rook
reviews.text: Just a great experience! Jessica needs a gold star as well as the maintenance techs that did the work. Professional and changed my tires quickly. Well done!!

reviews.author: Christy Tuttle
reviews.text: Black’s is the best auto service in Sanford, NC. Talk about honest technicians!! I was told at Sanford Ford after an appt to fix a recall that I needed new brakes and rotors. When following up with Black’s, they inspected all 4 brakes and rotors and the mechanic said, “If it were my vehicle, I wouldn’t replace anything right now,” saving me HUNDREDS!!! Hands down the most respectable place around. Hard to find honesty like that these days. They’ll always have my business. Thank you, Black’s!

reviews.author: Daniel Barry
reviews.text: I came into their shop 10 minutes before closing with a deflated donut on my car after my tire had popped. They swapped me for a new tire right before closing and ordered new tires to replace the other the following morning. Absolutely awesome crew, and great customer service!

reviews.author: Bob Albritton
reviews.text: Gary and the service personnel are outstanding. They were quick and efficient. They gave me a great price on four Michelin tires. I was out the door in an hour.

reviews.author: Kathleen Rosser
reviews.text: Within 1 hour of my phone call and driving to their store, I was in and out! Everyone was super friendly, and they understood my needs for a new battery! Little pricy, but considering they have to move brackets to even get to the battery. Advance Auto would not even touch it!

reviews.author: Jennifer Pippinger
reviews.text: Third time is a charm! These guys where the third tire shop I tried to get an old mini bike tire removed and a new one tire I had mounted. Lobby is clean and every one had fantastic attitude. Great experience will come back!

reviews.author: Jane Wade
reviews.text: 09/12/2025 Went to Black's Tire in Sanford today and had a great experience. Had a issue with my car and they jumped right in to check it out and fixed my issue and showed me what the problem was. Back on the road with ease. Thanks for fixing my car. Jessica and Tony are always so happy and friendly and very helpfull! I highly recommend Black's Tire for all services. Very friendly staff also. Very pleased with them each time I go. Everyone should try Black's tire. They are the best.

reviews.author: Bill Colebrook
reviews.text: Enjoyed my experience with Black's tire. They did everything I asked and in a timely manner. I was satisfied with the price on my 4 new tires. Will recommend to my friends

reviews.author: Robin Gonia
reviews.text: I needed new tires and took it to this location. Everyone there was friendly and very efficient. I dropped my vehicle off that morning and by 4:30 they had ordered and replaced my tires and done an alignment. I will definitely be using their services again! Thank you for the great service!

reviews.author: Anna Perrell
reviews.text: Money grab. Failed my car and was going to charge me over 400 for new tires. My tires are perfectly fine. I had someone look at them afterward. The tread is double the minimum they need to be. When I said no they brought it down to over 300. Expensive. Told me they’d let my tint slide if I paid the outrageous amount. Then charged me 10 dollars for my tint because I didn’t pay them for the tires. Would not recommend coming here.

reviews.author: Vincent Cameron
reviews.text: I was very pleased with their service. They worked hard to squeeze me in on such a short notice. And I got it done thank you

reviews.author: Ronald Cheek
reviews.text: I called Black Tire for price and availability of a set of tires for my wife's car. They said they didn't have the tires that I wanted on hand, but could have them in the store in an hour. I arrived at the store in approximately an hour, tires were there. Once tires were installed I asked if they could also do an alignment. Little less than 90 minutes I was on my way. Great service and great employees.

reviews.author: William Maddox
reviews.text: Came in early for an oil change and a slow leak in one tire. Went straight to service counter, stated request , and vehicle was taken in for service. Oil change was underway and nail in tire was located. Due to location of nail and condition of other tires , I was offered the best option. I received a new set of tires and oil change in short time. Great service and great pricing has made me a very satisfied customer.

reviews.author: Tracy Bousman
reviews.text: I was extremely pleased with the service I got. The store Manager Jessica Was very personable and professional. I would definitely recommend this store to anyone that needs that type of service.

reviews.author: Terry Wallace
reviews.text: I walked in expecting to make an appointment probably later in the week for oil change and tires tube rotated. They said ok we will get it done and this was at 330 and they found my front brakes needed to be replaced and they finished by 515. The waiting was clean and cool!!!

reviews.author: Deborah Hairr
reviews.text: Kind friendly staff. Called beforehand for a price and they stuck with the quote they gave me. They were $250 below another quote I received. I will use them again.

reviews.author: Rita Hines
reviews.text: Love Black's tire. I was so impressed with the honesty and integrity of Black's Tire. When I was told by a local company I need to replace my brakes and rotors , they took the time to do a thorough inspection and were honest with me that they were still in great shape. I really appreciate their commitment to providing honest and high-quality service. Sometimes paying $19.95 will save, compared toa $399.00 replacement of your brake system. I'll definitely be back for future repairs!

reviews.author: Michael Laudate
reviews.text: Had my car inspected. Very quick! Had me in and out in no time. Didn’t think to TIME it, I was out so quickly!

reviews.author: Cemetery Angels
reviews.text: I frequent Sanford, Broadway a good bit. Locals know to go here and on such recommends have been in twice. The place has a big heart, lot of character and offer quality service at fair to less than costly pricing which of course is just my experience. I'm almost shocked that a Mavis is opening around the corner which is a sign of anticipated growth but really cannot imagine locals patronizing it on the regular when a place like Black's is so entrenched and time honored. All the same, I'm sticking with Black's Tire & Auto Service!

reviews.author: Sandra Britt
reviews.text: I am never disappointed every time I go to get an oil change ect… they do a great job. let me know if anything is wrong give suggestions never pushy! Very honest. I recommend them highly. Bonnie is amazing with her knowledge about vehicles, I have been going for several years and they are always so kind! And the price is right!

reviews.author: Ronald Hewett
reviews.text: I needed a quick tire change to replace a damaged tire. I came in to Blacks at 4 pm. That was late to expect service, but I was needing help. The woman at the counter quickly ran out to check my tire, checked her stock, found one that I needed across town, dispatched a courier to pick it up and then had it put onthe car. Unbelievable! Quick, courteous and professional! What a GREAT experience! Shame on me for not getting her name, but I will come back to Blacks.

reviews.author: Melissa Arnold
reviews.text: The front desk service was great!! The guy discussed different brands of tires and I ended up going with his recommendation. My alignment almost got missed had I not inquired once the technician brought my car back to the front.

reviews.author: Jonathan Moulder
reviews.text: The BEST!! Wanted to shout out and let everyone know it. Wonderful and great service with a smile and they were concerned with me and my needs regarding my car. Best service I could ask for. Thank you especially to Mrs. Bonnie as she took our requests and made them possible. This team is amazing!! If you're looking for a great place to get service, I highly recommend them.

reviews.author: paco
reviews.text: Bonnie & Rob were great. They handled a problem with my tire right away. I was able to get on with my afternoon within a half hour. We’ve taken our autos there in the past & service has been excellent and reasonable.

reviews.author: Tammy Parrish
reviews.text: Paid for 4 new tires and an alignment. Asked for alignment report over the span of a week, 2 phone calls and three in-person visits. Finally told “we must have overlooked the alignment, we will get it done today, no charge”. Really? No charge for you doing the thing I paid for a week prior. Wow, thanks. Was a customer here a long time, generally dealt with Gary. Not dealing with these shady people. At least have integrity and admit your mistake as soon as you realized (on the first phone call) and offer to make it right instead of brushing me off and hoping I run out of persistence on the matter.

reviews.author: Ernest Turman
reviews.text: These people are on point. It’s like dealing with the true life Andy Griffith gas station people, just as fun, professional and able to take care of you and your vehicles. I love our people on Main Street Sanford. Thank you for getting me in and out!

reviews.author: Thomas Pacenza
reviews.text: I needed their service as I couldn't access my spare tire. They were amazing, took my truck in right away and gave me a very fair price. Though I don't live in the area, I would highly recommend Black's! Thank you.

reviews.author: Kayla Sims
reviews.text: Had an unexpected start to my day and they got me right in and replaced my blown tire within an hour! I will definitely be back! They were so kind and helpful in a stressful situation!

reviews.author: Cosmic Girl
reviews.text: Very friendly local business. I had a nail in my tire that could not be plugged and because of some wear on all the tires, I ended up needing all of them replaced. I was given several options for price. The tires were ordered and arrived promptly and did not have to wait too long even though the place was busy. I was also offered a tire insurance that will cover tire replacement in case of damage (I.e nails and objects that seem to get embedded every six months). Plus: they support local animal rescue organization

reviews.author: JuNiya
reviews.text: Jessica needs a raise!!! she is the very best person i’ve ever worked with when it comes to going to a tire shop ! No hidden fees and great customer service. i highly recommend her !!!

reviews.author: Megan Browning
reviews.text: I have used this business for state inspections since moving into the area. They are always kind, professional, and honest. I have greatly appreciated their fair and competitive prices too.

reviews.author: Kevin Hutchinson
reviews.text: I have been quite pleased with the professionalism, cleanliness of the place, quality of the work and the willingness of the mechanics to educate me about my Toyota Tacoma from one service to the next. It means a lot to me to have people just as enthused as I am about keeping the old truck running strong and safe to drive out on the roadways.

reviews.author: H Staverman
reviews.text: Wonderful experience. The technicians were quick, the service desk associates were efficient and easy to speak with. I love the text message telling me my car was ready.

reviews.author: Victor Tobias
reviews.text: Service and customer care were exceptional. Can't express enough the patience and knowledge passed onto me for services extended to customers like myself. Will be doing business with these folks for a while.

reviews.author: Bradley Borba
reviews.text: That ladies behind the counter are always nice. It's first come first serve so sometimes there is a wait. But they seem to work pretty efficiently. The prices aren't the cheapest but also not the most expensive so I guess right on target. I would definitely recommend based on my past experiences with this company.

reviews.author: Sharonda Woods
reviews.text: I called to get service and they worked me in very quickly the same day. I wasn't expecting that but am very appreciative. The staff was very friendly and professional!!!! Definitely going back for my auto needs!

reviews.author: Brett Schack
reviews.text: Been here a few times. Very friendly and professional. And provides outstanding service. Only downside is to there is no scheduling system. So, drop your vehicle off as soon as they open to get it back the same day depending on your service. Will be coming for future maintenance services.

reviews.author: Tonya the Funeral Director
reviews.text: Great customer service! Staff very personable and professional. Techs explained everything that was done and ensured that my vehicle was given back the same way they received it

reviews.author: Ty Williams
reviews.text: Great service. They diagnosed the problem and got the work done very quickly. The manager is top notch!

reviews.author: Matthew Blell
reviews.text: Big thanks to Tony for working with my son and I to find the perfect tire for my sons truck. These guys went above and beyond!

reviews.author: Kate Lopiccolo
reviews.text: Best experience I have had in some time now. Get like the team knew what they were doing, and if not, would tell me. Professional and kind. Thank you for making it easy. So far so good anyway.

reviews.author: Sharon Graham
reviews.text: Walked in when my car tire sensor came on. The tire pressure had dropped and dropped again. Tracy was very helpful and friendly and got my car in quickly. It took some investigating but the culprit was found, removed and patched. Very happy with my experince.

reviews.author: Sarah marsh
reviews.text: New customer to this store. We moved to this store because of the manager. He is always honest and fair. We value people and businesses that conduct themselves this way and will continue to use this location as long as Tony and his team is there. Thanks for making sure we are driving away safe.

reviews.author: Stacy Wilson
reviews.text: Having just moved to the area Blacks will be my got to for auto service. I had tires replaced in August and an oil change in September. Both services were done efficiently and with in my budget. The front desk people vare amazing!!

reviews.author: Mary Julia Boyd
reviews.text: Normally I go there for oil and tire rotation. Always great. This last time I had an engine light and 4 W D light go on. I had been there a week before for oil and tire rotation and all was well. They said it was an exhaust problem and referred me to LA Customs which was closed that day so I went to another auto repair shop. They told me that because the tech at Nlack Tire had cleared the lights that went on knowing the code was not enough to diagnosis the exact area of concern. So now I have to wait till the lights go on again. Not a happy customer now.

reviews.author: jeff botellio
reviews.text: Great place, fast service, good price. Helped me in the nick of time when I had a leaking tire and a flat spare. 30 minutes in and out, super nice people. No tire store in Moore county had the size or an appointment available until Monday. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Misty Horne
reviews.text: They all had excellent customer service,didn't mind taking there time to explain things. Also I asked if they had wheel alignment coupons and they give me a 15 dollar discount. I was very overall impressed with blacks tire and will b back.

reviews.author: Gabriel Flores
reviews.text: Yes I got 4 tires installed on my escalade it took a minute but the lady & the man in the front were nice and friendly I also liked we had a waiting room with TV while we waited I had a good experience there I'm going there soon for my free rotation.

reviews.author: Felicia Love
reviews.text: Was looking for a set of tires, spoke with PHILLIP over the phone at the Main Street location. He was amazing Great Customer Service!!!! Very knowledgeable. He also got me in and out with in a hour.

reviews.author: Shawn Jones
reviews.text: I want to thank Bonnie and her great care with my daughters car. She worked hard in finding what we needed and getting it completed quickly. She made the experience feel as if we were part of her family. They will continue to get my business for years to come.

reviews.author: Cynthia Williams
reviews.text: My experience with Black’s Tire located on Main St., Sanford, NC was excellent. They were very courteous and prompt. Thank you for having a wonderful Business as this in our area.

reviews.author: Robert Newby
reviews.text: I had new tires put on my vehicle at Black’s Tire Service. The customer service was nice. They treated me with professionalism. I will continue to do business with this company.

reviews.author: Scott D
reviews.text: Top notch honest work. Blacks at Main St. - Prompt professional service at a fair price. Their tire/service/repair recommendations cover exactly what my vehicles need - nothing more nothing less. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Melissa Palmer
reviews.text: Black’s tire gives excellent service. I have been using Black’s Tire for years for great Goodyear tires and regular oil changes and service. Bonnie is absolutely the best and always makes sure I am taken care of. It is great to have this home town quality tire service so accessible.

reviews.author: Marvin Mack
reviews.text: For our first visit, the service was great and the staff seemed to be very knowledgeable. The wait time wasn’t long for stopping in without a scheduled appointment.

reviews.author: Monica Harris (Mo)
reviews.text: This was my first time coming in for an inspection at Black’s. The ladies at the desk were super friendly and helpful and they had my vehicle serviced really fast. I’ll be back!

reviews.author: NateJenny Garcia
reviews.text: I have been going to Black’s Tire for years. The staff are all so kind, honest and helpful. Thank you for making us feel so welcome. Flat tires, new tires, oil changes, brakes…we have done it all. All repairs have been quality and affordable.

reviews.author: Richard Dennis
reviews.text: Very friendly staff. Had them do a pre-purchase inspection. They squeezed me in. Also Chap, I believe the owner or manager, was familiar with the dealership I was purchasing the car from and shared some insights. I have always had good experience at any of these shops in different locations.

reviews.author: Lynette Manzer
reviews.text: The folks at Blacks Tire are very nice people. Took awhile to get my new set of tires put on but that just shows what a great bunch of people they are and in demand . Price is also good. Highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Ginger Wilder
reviews.text: Absolutely love love Bonnie. The mechanic was so so nice. Not taking my truck anywhere else. And I run across the road and shopped at the Pig while I waited. Love my Sanford peeps.

reviews.author: Jason Thomas
reviews.text: Excellent service! I came in mid day with a screw in my tire. After an hour later and for only 35$ I was back on the road!

reviews.author: Sarah Sillings
reviews.text: Great customer service! Ladies up front were super helpful and my pop-in inspection only took 15 minutes! Record time! Thanks guys!!

reviews.author: Jesus Andino
reviews.text: I rode in to have my Harley inspection done. I've had work done on my other vehicles here also. Everything from the front desk to the technicians are always pleasant, very knowledgeable and accurate in accomplishment time of work explained.

reviews.author: Debbie Brown
reviews.text: My experience here was as good as it gets. From the first person I saw when I arrived and the last one I saw when I picked up my car, they were all friendly, helpful, and professional. I would recommend Black’s Tire to any of my friends and family!

reviews.author: Hope Buchanan
reviews.text: The BEST place to service your vehicle. It’s difficult to find honest, trustworthy and knowledgeable people when it comes to servicing your car. This is what you get when you visit Black’s Tire on East Main Street. Bonnie Setzer is the reason I choose Black’s; she embodies all the above characteristics.

reviews.author: Y mergen
reviews.text: Go to Black's Tire. Honest, quality work! Very affordable! Excellent customer service! Thank you for the great work on all my vehicles! The best in Sanford!

reviews.author: Randall Newcomer
reviews.text: I had a flat right after they closed but I was close enough I got my car there. They stayed after and got my tire fixed. This saved my wife an extra 2 hours of drive time to come rescue me. I love Black's Tire. I've never had a bad experience at any of their offices.

reviews.author: Thomas Singleton
reviews.text: Black Tire is a good and reliable company. The worse part is my lacking of record/receipt keeping. Patience and awesome people

reviews.author: Mable
reviews.text: Excellent experience and value, as always. My husband and I have trusted our cars to their top-notch service for more than 15 years. Thank you!

reviews.author: Stewart Smith
reviews.text: Thanks for taking care of my flat tire situation quickly with being a walk-in customer with limited staff. I appreciate the excellent service in getting my vehicle back on the road with keeping safety the number 1 priority.

reviews.author: John Demers
reviews.text: Needed tires in a hurry. They got me in as soon as I pulled up and had my wife's car done within 40 minutes. Excellent customer service.

reviews.author: Dan & Robin Olah
reviews.text: The counter staff were great to work with. Friendly service and work was done in a timely fashion. Thank you

reviews.author: Maxwell Elliott
reviews.text: Just got a new tire for a very reasonable price and I was in and out pretty quick. Jessica has helped me out at the front desk a couple times now and makes the process super easy!

reviews.author: Jason Kimble
reviews.text: Great place to have your vehicle serviced!! Friendly and knowledgeable staff that treat you like family!!!

reviews.author: Trevon Williams
reviews.text: Bonnie and Jessica were great. They provide excellent service at a convenient price. Ron and John are wonderful mechanics. Thank you for all you do.

reviews.author: Julia Richardson
reviews.text: The service was prompt, the workers helpful, friendly, and honest. I thought a light was out, but I was told it was just loose, so it didn't need replacing. It as a great experience overall. Thank you!

reviews.author: Gale Green
reviews.text: I did not have a appointment and i needed to get my suv inspected and they were quick and friendly. I will go back and i will recommend Black’s Tires !!

reviews.author: Allison Sills
reviews.text: Great, fast and affordable service! Replaced a wheel sensor for less than HALF of what the dealership quoted. Got me in next day, and finished within the hour. Very friendly on the phone and in person. Recommend!

reviews.author: Krisitna Stevenson
reviews.text: This is my go to shop. They always get me in and out and do an amazing job. The ladies in the front are super friendly and funny too. I by pass plenty of shops on the way to this one just because of the quality and hospitality.

reviews.author: Hal Abshire
reviews.text: Courtesy and professional and best of all on and out in no time! Great job by the front desk in keeping me informed. Thanks to Tony and Jessica for all their help.

reviews.author: Denzel Green
reviews.text: Great Staff, very helpful and treated like family. They give you honest answers for every question you have for what you need done for your car

reviews.author: richard slater
reviews.text: Prompt, courteous service on tire repair. I am also pleased with my new set of tires purchased at Black’s last month.

reviews.author: bonita russell
reviews.text: Always friendly. Quickly addressed my issue- screw in tire- and explained what work may need to be performed. Fortunately I got good news! No through puncture so no work needed!

reviews.author: Sandra
reviews.text: My car inspection was done quickly with little wait time. The staff was very friendly and courteous. I highly recommend Black’s Tire and Auto Service.

reviews.author: Katherine Silberschlag
reviews.text: Went for routine inspection, advised a wait of about an hour. I was done within 30mins, along with a quote for new tires. Very friendly and professional.

reviews.author: Charles Buzzard
reviews.text: Needed a wheel alignment done fast and easy. Pulled in and 40 minutes later paid and went on my way. Very friendly and efficient.

reviews.author: Dolores Lola Hostert
reviews.text: I noticed that there was a large screw in my tire when I was leaving my workplace. I called them, and they fixed the tire quickly so I could be back on the road to get home safely. Thank you!

reviews.author: Larry King
reviews.text: I went in for a Safety Inspection and the Employee's are the Best for Service and Customer aid ! They all are SUPER POLITE and make the. Customer feel Welcome ! I would Recommend that automotive Service Business to anyone , They are GREAT !

reviews.author: Mike Harrelson
reviews.text: Having another oil change and service. Great people and customer service. They keep you in the loop every step of the way. Price is Right and competitive with others. I really do appreciate and recommend this place. They have great tires as well.

reviews.author: Brooke Pendergrass
reviews.text: Great customer service from the communication, the friendly staff and wait time. Highly recommend and will continue to come back here.

reviews.author: Darlene Knight
reviews.text: Had an unexpected problem with a tire. Was sent to Black's Tire. They were able to fix my tire within an hour and were very nice while we waited. Thans so much!!

reviews.author: Cynthia Bunting
reviews.text: This was my first visit to this location and it was a fantastic experience Mr. Gary and Jessica are simply amazing I will continue to take my car back there for service in the future

reviews.author: timothy tighe
reviews.text: Fast, friendly & efficient. My fifth or sixth visit, still the same results. Alignment always done properly. All my vehicles go here now. Even for inspections.

reviews.author: Tsubaki Hoshiko
reviews.text: Been going here for years with my godparents and they still have great service. The only thing I could gripe about is wait time but I know they are doing the best they can.

reviews.author: Carrie Cole
reviews.text: I had work done on my 1989 RV. They did a great job on my brake system. Being disabled and I have a hard time walking, the only thing I did not like was the long distance between the door and the service desk.

reviews.author: John Fiore
reviews.text: Got my oil changed 4 new tires it was 4:30pm. Going to Chicago in the morning. Everything finished by 5:30..I am in Chicago now..so far so good...Thank you Black Tire.

reviews.author: Ariane Smith
reviews.text: Black's Tire took the time to help me find the part I needed for my car at the very best price. Every time I come here I truly feel they treat their clients as they would like to be treated.

reviews.author: Heidi Shearin
reviews.text: The crew at Black Tire in Jonesboro area of Sanford take care of my family's vehicle needs, both for normal maintenance and for repairs. They are friendly, efficient and trustworthy.

reviews.author: Darryl Wright
reviews.text: We have been customers of Perry Brothers on E. Main St Sanford NC for over six years. Never had any issues, great customer service, and very friendly, and we're not friends or family members.

reviews.author: Chris Newcomb
reviews.text: Best place around for service and tires. Never had any problems and always very honest and helpful. Reasonably priced compared to others too.

reviews.author: R Scott Bullard
reviews.text: The staff went above and beyond with a difficult servicing of my old truck. And they do stand by their work! I thank Black's Tire they are good people!

reviews.author: Lisa Hillen
reviews.text: Always have good service! Tony inspected my car thoroughly and reassured me that my 15 year old car is in fine condition.

reviews.author: Keri W.
reviews.text: A speedy, professional experience! Even with a waiting room full of people, my car was serviced quickly, and everyone was very kind. I'll be back for sure!

reviews.author: Mark Bassham
reviews.text: These guys know what they are doing! Do yourself a favor and stop and see Black Tire & Auto Service! You will be glad you did!!

reviews.author: Neil Godfrey
reviews.text: The staff are very knowledgeable about tires and very professional. They did an excellent job helping us select the correct tires for our car!

reviews.author: Frankie Spinks
reviews.text: Been there many times before, went just to have my car looked at underneath because of strange noise coming from front tire. It turned out to be nothing, it was fast and cost nothing.
